description: Ministry of Labour - Industrial Disputes Between Commercial Bank of Ceylon Plc. Vs. Ceylon Bank Employees Union (E Only)
reasoning: This gazette content publishes a Collective Agreement between a bank and a trade union under the Industrial Disputes Act.
